methodology: Public-runtime compatibility revision: all 600 frozen v12 case objects, IDs, source references and expected outcomes are inherited byte-identically.
The authorship record describes the original synthetic case authorship, not new case authoring in this revision.
No expected result is recomputed or relabeled by this generator; original v12 artifacts and their release seal remain unchanged.

Dependency and evaluator-source pins are refreshed for the deployment-compatible publication source and historical-session reader; new validator and replay receipts are produced by actual offline acceptance runs.
Coverage semantics, six suite gates and zero contribution to the 28-case deep score are unchanged.

Replay blocks fetch from evaluator module load through execution and traps the declared time/random APIs during case execution; it does not claim instrumentation of module-initialization time/randomness or native HTTP clients.

claimBoundary.disclosure: This 600-case corpus extends deterministic implementation coverage. It does not replace the v2 28-case deep score, certify financial correctness, or constitute independent expert validation.

limitations: Code-grounded labels can share assumptions with the implementation under test.
No independent finance, legal, privacy, or security expert has reviewed every label.
Stored API contract cases do not prove public deployment availability or current upstream data quality.
Subjective innovation, business value, and presentation quality remain outside this automatic corpus.
